# Input — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for an input when the answer is one short line: a name, an email, a search term, a quantity. Wrap it in a Field so the label, help text and error are wired to it — an input on its own has no label and no way to report a problem. Pick the `type` that matches the answer, because it changes the keyboard on a phone and the validation the browser offers for free. If the answer is longer than a line, that is a textarea; if it is one of a known set of values, that is a select.

### Usage

**Do**

- Use outlined as the default — it works on any surface.
- Use filled where the field sits on a lower surface and needs separation.
- Label every field — floating label, placeholder, or an external label with `aria-label`.

**Don't**

- Don't leave a field unlabeled — a bare box means nothing to a screen reader.
- Don't use a field where a fixed choice fits — that is a select, radio group, or checkbox.
- Don't pass a sibling FieldMessage alongside `errorMessage` — the prop owns it.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Outlined container | resting | comp.outlined-text-field.container-shape | corner-extra-small 4px, 1px outline |
| Outlined border | focus | comp.outlined-text-field.focus-outline-color | --sys-color-primary, 2px |
| Filled container | resting | comp.filled-text-field.container-color | --sys-color-surface-container-highest |
| Filled indicator | focus | comp.filled-text-field.focus-active-indicator-color | --sys-color-primary, 2px |
| Input text | resting | sys.typescale.body-large | 16px / 24px, body-large |
| Input text | disabled | comp.outlined-text-field.disabled-input-text-opacity | on-surface 38% |
| Outlined border | disabled | comp.outlined-text-field.disabled-outline-opacity | on-surface 12% |

### FAQ

**Filled or outlined?**

Functionally identical — pick by surface. Filled separates on lower surfaces; outlined works everywhere.

**How do errors work?**

Pass `error` for the state or `errorMessage` for state plus text. The message implies the state and renders as a live alert associated to the field.

## Native

### Features

Reach for an input when the answer is free text. It is React Native's `TextInput` with kern's field behaviour on top, and the useful part is how it relates to a field: if you render it inside `Field.Root` it picks up the label and the error from context automatically, so its accessible name is right without you passing anything. On its own it is a plain text field and you name it yourself. The error state exists because React Native has no `accessibilityState.invalid` — so the error is announced through `accessibilityHint` instead, which is a platform substitution worth knowing about rather than a styling choice.

### Usage

**Do**

- Pick the variant by surface: `outlined` draws the `1px` outline, `filled` fills `surfaceContainerHighest` with a bottom indicator.
- Mark errors with `error` plus `errorMessage` — the message rides the focused hint because native has no invalid state.
- Let the enclosing field own the label where one exists (`field.label` becomes the accessible label automatically).

**Don't**

- Don't read `placeholder` as the label — it is the unfilled state's example text, announced only until entry starts.
- Don't disable by styling alone — `editable={false}` carries the disabled state the placeholder and text colors follow.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Outlined field | resting | theme.color.outline | 1px outline on surface, minHeight 56 |
| Filled field | resting | theme.color.surfaceContainerHighest | surfaceContainerHighest fill, extra-small top corners |
| Field border | error | theme.color.error | error border via `error` or the field's error |
| Entered text | resting | theme.color.onSurface | onSurface, 16px / 24px |
| Placeholder | resting | theme.color.onSurfaceVariant | onSurfaceVariant (38% onSurface when disabled) |

### FAQ

**How is an error announced?**

React Native has no invalid state, so the error message joins the focused field's hint and `FieldMessage` adds the live alert nearby. `error` paints the border; `errorMessage` speaks.

**Filled or outlined?**

Functionally identical — pick by surface. Outlined draws the full 1px outline; filled fills the container and rounds only the top corners.
